tex_content.html:
Corollary
[flatness of homogeneous metrics with nonpositive Ricci curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0333 ↗ thm:pet-ch8-bochner-negative-ricci 1. ch8:8.2.5A compact homogeneous space with $\mathrm{Ric}\le 0$ is flat. In particular, any Ricci-flat homogeneous space is flat.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch8-homogeneous-negative-ricci-flat \sketch By item 3, all Killing fields are parallel. Homogeneity makes their values span every tangent space. Thus every tangent vector extends locally to a parallel field, which forces the curvature tensor to vanish.

□
